seed: The recording used to its last frame and a second clip dropped after it at full length leave a cut with no spare frames either side. The picker greys the transitions that need an overlap, Properties says why and offers Shorten the cut by 0.4s, and choosing it trims 0.2s off each clip end, closes the gap and puts the cross dissolve on, as one step to undo. Command T at the same cut keeps its dip fallback. At Next defaults, no flag set.

steps.control: Edit point Tutorial Sample to b-roll

steps.note: THE FIRST TEST: both clips run to their own last and first frames, so the cut has nothing either side to borrow. The picker greys Cross dissolve, Push, Wipe and Blur through and says spare 0.0s / 0.0s along its top; the dips stay available. Properties says No spare frames for an overlap and offers Or, Shorten the cut by 0.4s

steps.reads: No spare frames for an overlap

steps.note: THE SECOND TEST: one click took 0.2s off the end of the recording and 0.2s off the start of b-roll, closed the gap so b-roll now starts at 0:07.8, and put a 0.4s cross dissolve on the cut, paid for with exactly the frames it trimmed. The dashed spare strips either side of the band, the Spare after and Spare before fields and Paid with all agree: 0.2s each side. The playhead is half way through, so the canvas shows both shots
THE THIRD TEST: one undo puts both clip ends back and takes the dissolve off: the cut is at 0:08 again and hard

steps.control: Edit point Tutorial Sample to b-roll

steps.note: Command T at the same cut does not shorten anything: a key never moves clips. It says No transition added and offers the dip the cut can take, and nothing on the timeline moved
